scholarship_name: Prime Minister'S Scholarship Scheme For Wards Of States/UTs  Police Personnel Martyred During Terror/Naxal Attacks (Merit Based Scheme)
provider: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme (PMSS), Ministry of Home Affairs
eligibility: Wards/widows of deceased Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs) & Assam Rifles personnel who died in harness/election duty
Wards of CAPFs & AR personnel disabled due to causes attributable to Government service
Wards of ex‑CAPFs & AR personnel who are recipients of Gallantry Awards
Wards/widows of retired and serving CAPFs & AR personnel (below Officer Rank) pursuing a first professional degree programme
Dependent wards of States/UTs Police personnel who are martyred during Terror/Naxal attacks pursuing a first professional degree programme
Minimum 60% marks in Minimum Entry Qualification (10+2/Diploma/Graduation or equivalent) for new applicants
Minimum 50% marks in each subsequent academic year for renewal applicants
Grace period of one year allowed for delayed renewal applications
award_amount: Rs 3,000 per month for girls (Rs 36,000 per year) and Rs 2,500 per month for boys (Rs 30,000 per year)
education_level: First professional degree (undergraduate and postgraduate programmes such as MBA, MCA)
required_documents: Service Certificate issued by the Head Office (for serving personnel)
Attested mark sheet of Minimum Entry Qualification (10+2/Diploma/Graduation)
PPO/Discharge Certificate/Service Book (mandatory for categories A‑F)
Disability Certificate (mandatory for categories B & D)
Death Certificate (mandatory for categories A & C)
Certificate of Gallantry Award (mandatory for category E)
Bonafide certificate issued by the institute/college
Certificate from State Government indicating martyrdom of the police personnel (for States/UTs Police wards)
For renewal applicants: Service Certificate (if applicable), bonafide certificate, and attested mark sheet of the professional course pursued in the previous academic year
Aadhaar number (seeded with bank account) – mandatory for all applicants
renewal_requirements: Must have passed each subsequent academic year of the professional course with at least 50% marks
Grace period of one year allowed for delayed renewal submission
Upload Service Certificate (if serving), bonafide certificate, and mark sheet of the previous academic year
Maintain Aadhaar‑linked bank account; complete Aadhaar verification if not already done
No change of course/college without permission; otherwise scholarship will be cancelled

scholarship_name: AICTE - Swanath Scholarship Scheme ( Technical Degree) (Welfare Based Scheme)
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
eligibility: Orphan
Either or both parents died due to Covid‑19
Wards of Armed Forces or Central Paramilitary Forces martyred in action (Shaheed)
Parent suffering from a critical life‑threatening disease or severely disabled (as per RPwD Act 2016)
Family annual income not exceeding Rs. 8,00,000 (valid income certificate required)
Currently studying in an AICTE‑approved institution at Degree or Diploma level in regular mode (1st to 4th year)
Not a recipient of any Central/State Govt. or AICTE‑sponsored scholarship
award_amount: Rs. 50,000 per annum (maximum 4 years for Degree students, 3 years for Diploma students)
required_documents: Death certificate of both parents (or orphan certificate issued by Tehsildar/SDM)
Bonafide certificate issued by the institution
10+2/equivalent mark sheet (for Degree level applicants)
10th mark sheet (for both Degree and Diploma level applicants)
Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC‑NCL)
Current year income certificate (family income < Rs. 8 lakh)
Shaheed certificate (for wards of Armed Forces/Central Paramilitary Forces)
Aadhaar number (mandatory for application)
renewal_requirements: Submission of promotion certificate for the next year of study
Bonafide certificate from the Head of the Institution
Renewal application submitted through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) within the stipulated time

scholarship_name: PM USP Special Scholarship Scheme For Jammu Kashmir And Ladakh (Merit Based Scheme)
provider: Scholarships Division, Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
eligibility: Domicile of Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir or Ladakh
Passed Class XII examination from JKBOSE or CBSE affiliated schools located in the UTs
Family annual income of Rs. 8.00 lakh or less
For lateral entry candidates: must have a Diploma in Engineering from a Polytechnic recognized by the Directorate of Technical Education, UTs of J&K and Ladakh
Must apply online through the AICTE portal and verify documents at the nearest Facilitation Center
Admission must be through AICTE counselling under the super‑numerary quota (except management quota)
Must secure admission in eligible Government or AICTE‑approved institutions as per the scheme criteria
award_amount: Maintenance allowance of Rs. 1,00,000 per annum (paid in instalments) plus academic fee reimbursement up to Rs. 30,000 for General Degree courses, Rs. 1,25,000 for Professional/Engineering courses, and Rs. 3,00,000 for Medical courses
eligible_courses: General Degree Courses (e.g., Arts, Science, Commerce)
Hotel Management and Catering Technology (HMCT) Degree
BA LLB (in National Law Colleges only)
Medical courses (MBBS/BDS) subject to NEET qualification
required_documents: Certificate of domicile of Jammu & Kashmir or Ladakh
Certificate of Class XII (and Class X) examination
Polytechnic Diploma Certificate (for lateral entry candidates)
Income certificate issued by the competent authority of the UT
Caste certificate (SC/ST/SEBC/EWS) for candidates applying under reserved quota
Disability certificate (40% or above) for PwD candidates
renewal_requirements: Renewal is subject to good conduct and maintenance of attendance as prescribed by the institution
Student must be promoted to the next class/level; failure to promote twice results in forfeiture of the scholarship
If unable to appear for the annual examination due to illness or unforeseen circumstances, a medical certificate and other proof must be submitted to the Head of the Institution for renewal
Scholarship will not be paid twice for the same academic year

scholarship_name: National Scholarship For Post Graduate Studies (Merit Based Scheme)
eligibility: Must be applying for the first postgraduate (PG) degree programme only
Must have already been admitted to the first year of a PG programme in an eligible university/college/institution
For integrated programmes, scholarship applies only to the PG component
Applicant must be below 30 years of age on the date of admission to the first semester/year of the PG programme
Admission must be through regular/full‑time mode (open/distance, part‑time, private modes are not eligible)
Must be pursuing a recognized PG degree programme leading to a specified PG degree notified by UGC
Must hold a recognized undergraduate degree from an institution covered under Section 2(f) or Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956 or authorized to award degrees under section 22(1) of the UGC Act
award_amount: Rs.15,000 per month for 10 months per year, payable for two years
eligible_courses: PG degree programmes specified by UGC (as per the UGC Notification on Specification of Degrees, 2014, as amended)
Arts, Humanities, Social Sciences, Law, Management
Science, Engineering & Technology, Medical, Technical, Agriculture, Forestry
required_documents: Aadhaar‑linked bank account details (bank account number, IFSC code, etc.)
Certificate issued by competent authority for Caste/Category (if applicable)
Academic certificates and mark sheets (UG degree, UG marks, XII class marks) for verification
Any other certificates or affidavits requested by the institution to confirm eligibility
renewal_requirements: Maintain good conduct and prescribed attendance during the first year of study
Successful completion of the first year of the PG programme
Apply for renewal on the National e‑Scholarship Portal within the stipulated time frame
No change in course of study or institution during the scholarship period
